text: briefed: converter, Python .peo reader and golden --peo only (content/ stays TOML); split for effort: core load_content on .peo PEO-142, switch content/ and tools PEO-143. Title still says 'switch both loaders' (tool cannot rename). Briefed against peo.py/peo_format.hpp as on this branch while PEO-135 is in rework (CI fix only)

commits: 5b42ce7 docs (content-format.md 'Converting from TOML': path, field, value tables, range fields, reference fields by type), 5770a69 to_peo.py, 9e3169b peo_load.py, 2d7dbef golden.py --peo (independent back_to_toml), 4510882 tests/content/peo_convert fixture + expected + test.py checks. tests: verify.py --frontend --full all stages passed; golden --peo: 0 differences over content/ (1,570 records in 30 types, 4 merged tables, every resolved item) and over the fixture; an injected bug (+1 g on every mass) gives 887 differences; the converted tree (113 files, 1.1 MB, 1,574 records) parses with 0 errors in peo.py and peo_peo_dump exits 0; two conversions are byte-identical; 5 refusals probed (bad key, colliding keys, 0.333 float, unknown ref, bad ID). perf (one run, same machine): peo_load 596 ms on the converted tree vs common.load 127 ms on content/. manual: read items/tools/hand_tools.peo (claw_hammer under item.hammer), world/rooms/office.peo (purpose overrides keyed drawer/cupboard), registry/scent.peo: they read like content-format.md sections 1 to 9 apart from names, word scales and category segments. Rules I added beyond the brief's tables (in the docs section; worth an architect look): (1) a digit-leading ID part gets a leading '_' in paths (emits.rot.1 -> def.tag.emits.rot._1; cat.ammo.12ga, cat.battery.9v likewise), read back without it; PEO-143 may prefer renaming those tags; (2) suffixes strip only from numeric values, so schema records and a part named fill keep their keys; (3) rigidity_min and param_or_dim_min are minimums, not minutes, and keep their names; clock_min_days becomes clock_min in d; (4) every mul factor is a percent, int 2 included (200%), since two rope_100ft ops multiply by 2; (5) outdoor_set item names item or loot (struggle_debris is a loot table); (6) profile slots keep none and any as words; a tag ref is valid when its namespace exists (child tags such as cat.ammo.12ga are not records). back_to_toml needs one exception table entry: shape.fill is a plain key though fill_pct becomes fill elsewhere
